1. Purpose

To ensure that all patients are aware of their rights and responsibilities during their interaction with the hospital and that hospital staff respect, protect, and uphold these rights in all circumstances.

2. Scope

This SOP applies to:

  • All patients, attendants, and caregivers.
  • All hospital staff, including doctors, nurses, technicians, administrative, and support personnel.

3. Responsibility

  • Hospital Management: To implement and monitor compliance with patient rights and responsibilities.
  • Quality Department: To ensure display, training, and periodic review.
  • All Staff: To respect and uphold patient rights and communicate responsibilities to patients and families.

4. Definitions

  • Patient Rights: Legal and ethical entitlements of patients during care.
  • Patient Responsibilities: Expected behaviors and cooperation by patients to facilitate quality care delivery.

5. Procedure

A. Patient Rights

Every patient shall have the right to:

  • Access to Care
    • Receive appropriate medical care irrespective of race, religion, gender, age, or socioeconomic status.
  • Respect and Dignity
    • Be treated with courtesy, respect, and dignity in a safe and secure environment.
  • Privacy and Confidentiality
    • Expect that all personal and medical information will be kept confidential except when disclosure is required by law.
  • Informed Consent
    • Receive full information about diagnosis, treatment options, risks, and benefits before giving consent.
  • Information and Education
    • Obtain clear, complete, and understandable information about their illness, treatment, and expected outcomes.
  • Participation in Care
    • Participate in decision-making related to their treatment and care plan.
  • Refusal of Treatment
    • Refuse treatment (to the extent permitted by law) after being informed of the consequences.
  • Continuity of Care
    • Be assured of continuity of care, including referral or transfer when medically indicated.
  • Access to Medical Records
    • Review their medical records and obtain a summary upon request, as per hospital policy.
  • Safety and Quality
    • Receive care in a safe setting, free from abuse, neglect, or harassment.
  • Grievance Redressal
    • Lodge complaints or suggestions regarding care or services and expect a fair review and timely response.

B. Patient Responsibilities

Every patient (and their family/attendant) has the responsibility to:

  • Provide Accurate Information
    • Give complete and truthful information about their medical history and current condition.
  • Follow Treatment Plan
    • Follow the prescribed treatment, medication, and instructions given by healthcare providers.
  • Respect and Consideration
    • Treat hospital staff, other patients, and visitors with courtesy and respect.
  • Adhere to Hospital Rules
    • Abide by hospital policies regarding visiting hours, infection control, smoking, etc.
  • Financial Responsibility
    • Ensure timely payment for services rendered as per hospital billing policy.
  • Keep Appointments
    • Be punctual and inform the hospital in advance in case of cancellation or delay.
  • Safeguard Personal Belongings
    • Take care of personal items and valuables; the hospital will not be responsible for their loss.
  • Participate in Care
    • Actively participate in the treatment plan and communicate concerns or noncompliance.

6. Display and Communication

  • Patient Rights & Responsibilities shall be displayed prominently in English, Hindi, and regional languages at all patient care areas (OPD, IPD, Emergency, etc.).
  • A copy shall be included in the patient information booklet/admission kit.
  • Staff shall explain rights and responsibilities during admission and informed consent processes.

7. Training

All healthcare and non-clinical staff shall receive orientation and periodic training on patient rights and responsibilities.

8. Monitoring and Audit

  • The Quality Department shall conduct periodic audits to ensure adherence.
  • Patient feedback and complaint records shall be reviewed monthly for compliance.
